defect_taxonomy_and_containment.name: Cold Solder Joint / Poor Wetting
defect_taxonomy_and_containment.containment: Quarantine workpiece to Red Bin; re-flow at 350°C with RMA rosin flux; verify 100% under 10x optics.

defect_taxonomy_and_containment.name: ESD Damage / Gate Leakage
defect_taxonomy_and_containment.containment: Halt work; test operator wristband (<1 MΩ); replace damaged IC; verify anti-static earth path.

defect_taxonomy_and_containment.name: Solder Bridging / SMT Short
defect_taxonomy_and_containment.containment: Apply copper desolder wick with mild flux; clear bridge; verify continuity with DMM.
defect_taxonomy_and_containment.threshold: 3 occurrences per batch triggers stencil check
